use_cases: Displaying expandable contact information in a Linear-style card format
Opening a dialog overlay with additional contact details on click
Providing a clean, animated contact reveal experience for user profiles
Serving as a reusable contact card component in modern web applications
Enabling modal-style interactions with smooth motion transitions
ai_summary: A contact card component with dialog functionality that reveals additional information on click. Built with motion animations and a minimalist visual style inspired by Linear's design system. Uses context-based state management for open/close behavior and includes smooth transition effects. Suitable for SaaS applications, developer tools, and any modern web interface requiring elegant contact information display.
